aggregate.description:
A single notification dispatched to a recipient via a channel.

Notifications are created reactively from cross-domain events. Each
notification tracks its delivery lifecycle for audit and retry.
aggregate.name: Notification

notifications.notification.cancellation..description: Request to cancel a pending or scheduled notification.
notifications.notification.cancellation..name: CancelNotification

notifications.notification.retry.RetryNo.description: Request to retry a failed notification.
notifications.notification.retry.RetryNo.name: RetryNotification

notifications.notification.scheduler.Pro.description: Request to process all due scheduled notifications.
notifications.notification.scheduler.Pro.name: ProcessScheduledNotifications

notifications.notification.dispatch.Noti.description: Dispatches notifications via channel adapters when they are created.
notifications.notification.dispatch.Noti.name: NotificationDispatcher

notifications.notification.events.Notifi.description: A notification was created and queued for dispatch.
notifications.notification.events.Notifi.name: NotificationCreated

notifications.notification.events.Notifi.description: A notification was confirmed delivered to the recipient.
notifications.notification.events.Notifi.name: NotificationDelivered

notifications.notification.events.Notifi.description: A notification failed to send or deliver.
notifications.notification.events.Notifi.name: NotificationFailed

notifications.notification.events.Notifi.description: A notification was sent to the channel adapter.
notifications.notification.events.Notifi.name: NotificationSent

aggregate.description:
A customer's notification channel preferences.

Controls which channels (email, SMS, push) the customer receives
notifications on, quiet hours, and per-type unsubscribe.
aggregate.name: NotificationPreference

notifications.preference.management.Upda.description: Update a customer's notification channel preferences.
notifications.preference.management.Upda.name: UpdateNotificationPreferences

notifications.preference.subscription.Re.description: Resubscribe a customer to a previously unsubscribed notification type.
notifications.preference.subscription.Re.name: ResubscribeToType

notifications.preference.subscription.Un.description: Unsubscribe a customer from a specific notification type.
notifications.preference.subscription.Un.name: UnsubscribeFromType

notifications.preference.events.Channels.description: A customer's notification channel preferences were changed.
notifications.preference.events.Channels.name: ChannelsUpdated

notifications.preference.events.Preferen.description: Default notification preferences were created for a customer.
notifications.preference.events.Preferen.name: PreferencesCreated

notifications.preference.events.QuietHou.description: A customer cleared their do-not-disturb window.
notifications.preference.events.QuietHou.name: QuietHoursCleared

notifications.preference.events.QuietHou.description: A customer set their do-not-disturb window.
notifications.preference.events.QuietHou.name: QuietHoursSet

notifications.preference.events.TypeResu.description: A customer resubscribed to a previously unsubscribed notification type.
notifications.preference.events.TypeResu.name: TypeResubscribed

notifications.preference.events.TypeUnsu.description: A customer unsubscribed from a specific notification type.
notifications.preference.events.TypeUnsu.name: TypeUnsubscribed

notifications.notification.cart_subscrib.description:
Reacts to Cart events to send recovery notifications.

ACL pattern: receives raw broker message dict, extracts event type from
metadata.headers.type, and creates notifications. Ignores all event
types not relevant to the Notifications domain.
notifications.notification.cart_subscrib.name: CartEventsSubscriber
